desc.en: This Qunoot has been mentioned by Syed bin Taoos in his book Muhaj-ud-Daawaat and by Kaf’ami in Al Balad-ul-Amin, both narrating from Imam Baqir (a)…
desc.rurdu: Yeh Qunoot Syed ibne Taoos ne apni kitaab Muhaj-ud-Daawaat aur Kaf’ami Baladul Amin mein Imam Baqir (a) se riwaayat ki hai…
desc.urdu: یہ قنوت سید ابن طاؤس نے کتاب مهج الدعوات اور کعفمی نے کتاب البلد الأمين امام باقرؑ سے روایت کی ہے۔۔۔

trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: یَا مَن یَّعْلَمُ هَوَاجِسَ السِّرَائِرِ، وَمَكَامِنَ الضَّمَائِرِ، وَحَقَائِقَ الْخَوَاطِرِ، یَا مَنْ هُوَ لِكُلِّ غَیْبٍ حَاضِرٌ، وَلِكُلِّ مَنْسِیٍّ ذَاكِرٌ، وَعَلٰی كُلِّ شَیْءٍ قَادِرٌ، وَاِلَی الْكُلِّ نَاظِرٌ، بَعُدَ الْمَهَلُ، وَقَرُبَ الْاَجَلُ، وَضَعُفَ الْعَمَلُ، وَاَرَابَ الْاَمَلُ، وَآنَ الْمُنْتَقَلُ۔

trans.en: O He who is aware of the hidden ideas and that which is concealed in the inner self and the truth of ones mental thoughts; O He who is present before all that is unseen and the reminder of all that is forgotten, and is Able to do all things, and who guards and eyes everything; the time for performing good deeds has passed away, and death is nearing, and actions are weakening, hopes have reached the point of hopelessness, and the time to shift towards the Hereafter has arrived.
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: وَاَنْتَ یَا اَللهُ الْاَخِرُ كَمَا اَنْتَ الْاَوَّلُ، مُبِیْدُ مَا اَنَئْشَاتَ، وَمُصَیِّرُ هُمْ اِلَی الْبِلٰی، وَمُقَلِّدُهُمْ اَعْمَالَهُمْ، وَمُحَمِّلُهَا ظُهُوْرَهُمْ اِلٰی وَقْتِ نُشُوْرِهِمْ مِنْ بَعْثَۃِ قُبُوْرِهِمْ عِنْدَ نَفْخَۃِ الصُّوْرِ، وَانْشِقَاقِ السَّمَائِ بِالنُّوْرِ، وَالْخُرُوْجِ بِالْمَنْشَرِ اِلٰی سَاحَۃِ الْمَحْشَرِ، لَا تَرْتَدُّ اِلَیْهِمْ اَبْصَارُهُمْ وَاَفْئِدَتُهُمْ هَوَائٌ۔

trans.en: And You O Allah are the beginning just like You are the end, You will Yourself destroy all that You have created, and will stretch them towards deterioration and decaying, and will tie their deeds and character like a collar around their necks, and will lade their backs till the day when they will resurrect and scatter from their graves upon the blowing of the trumpet (by Israfeel) The day when the heaven will split asunder due to light, and after the announcement of their gathering they will arrive in the judgment ground, their gaze will not look return to them, and their hearts will be as air.

arabic.text: مُتَرَاطِمِیْنَ فِیْ غُمَّۃٍ مِّمَّا اَسْلَفُوْا، وَمُطَالَبِیْنَ بِمَا احْتَقَبُوْا، وَمُحَاسَبِیْنَ هُنَاكَ عَلٰی مَا ارْتَكَبُوْا، اَلصَّحَائِفُ فِیْ الْاَعْنَاقِ مَنْشُوْرَۃٌ، وَالْاَوْزَارُ عَلَی الظُّهُوْرِ مَازُوْرَۃٌ، لَا انْفِكَاكَ وَلَا مَنَاصَ وَلَامَحِیْصَ عَنِ الْقِصَاصِ قَدْ اَفْحَمَتْهُم الْحُجَّۃُ۔

trans.en: They will drown in the state of an unending grief due to their indecent deeds past, and they will be interrogated due to their past corruptions, and will be held accountable for the sins they committed, their deed-reports will hang around their necks, heavy burden will be laden on their backs, there will be no separation, no escape, and no evasion from retaliation. The apparent proof and reason has dumbstruck them and the criers have become astonished before the Divine evidences.

arabic.text: وَحَلُّوَا فِیْ حَیْرَۃِ الْمَحَجَّۃِ وَهُمْسِ الضَّجَّۃِ، مَعْدُوْلٌ بِهِمْ عَنِ الْمَحَجَّۃِ اِلَّا مَنْ سَبَقَتْ لَهٗ مِنَ اللهِ الْحُسْنٰی، فَنَجَا مِنْ هَوْلِ الْمَشْهَدِ وَعَظِیْمِ الْمَوْرِدِ، وَلَمْ یَكُنْ مِّمَّنْ فِی الدُّنْیَا تَمَرَّدَ، وَلَا عَلٰی اَوْلِیَائِ اللهِ تَعَنَّدَ، وَلَهُمُ اسْتَبْعَدَ، وَعَنْهُمْ بِحُقُوْقِهِمْ تَفَرَّدَ۔

trans.en: They will be deviated from the path except for those who were subject to Allah’s grace and mercy even in their past; such a person got delivered from the fright and terror of such a position which is immensely great and magnanimous, he was not amongst those in the world who went astray or envied the friends of Allah and distanced himself from them, and regarded their rights to be of his own.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ فَاِنَّ الْقُلُوْبَ قَدْ بِلَغَتِ الْحَنَاجِرَ، وَانُّفُوْسَ قَدْ عَلَتِ التَّرَاقِیَ، وَالْاَعْمَارَ قَدْ نَفِدَتْ بِالْاِنْتِظَارِ، لَا عَنْ نَقْضِ اسْتِبْصَارٍ، وَلَا عَنِ اتِّهَامِ مِقْدَارٍ، وَلٰكِنْ لِمَا تُعَانِیْ مِنْ رُكُوْبِ مَعَاصِیْكَ، وَالْخِلَافِ عَلَیْكَ فِیْ اَوَامِرِكَ وَنَوَاهِیْكَ، اَالتَّلَعُّبِ بِاَوْلِیَائِكَ وَمُظَاهَرَۃِ اَعْدَائِكَ۔

trans.en: O Allah, indeed the hearts have reached the throats, certainly the souls have come up till the necks, and lives are nearing their end in anticipation; this is not the result of a violation of perception, nor is it because of a conflict with destiny, but it is the outcome of my abundant wrongdoings, and my opposition to Your commands and Your preventions, and my mischief with Your friends and support extended to Your enemies.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ فَقَرِّبْ مَا قَدْ قَرُبَ، وَاَوْرِدْ مَا قَدْ دَنٰی، وَحَقِّقْ ظُنُوْنَ الْمُوْقِنِیْنَ، وَبَلِّغِ الْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ تَامِیْلَهُمْ، مِنْ اِقَامَۃِ حَقِّكَ، وَنَصْرِ دِیْنِكَ، وَاِظْهَارِ حُجَّتِكَ، وَالْاِنْتِقَامِ مِنْ اَعْدَائِكَ۔

trans.en: O Allah, bring nearer that which has already neared (the Faraj and relief), and send forth that has come close, make that happen which was believed by the holders of certainty, help the faithful attain the fruit of their hope, which is the establishment of truth, Your support for the religion, the appearance of Your proof and the revenge from Your enemies.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
